name: agent-kitchen
description: A kitchen for building, testing, improving, grounding, and auditing coding-agent harness artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: Build, test, improve, and audit agent harnesses.
interface.longDescription: Build the right harness artifact, ground it in supplied sources, run it against real prompts, repair it as evidence arrives, and audit the setup that loads it.
defaultPrompt: Design the right harness artifact for this task.
Audit this coding-agent harness end to end.
Ground a harness decision in these sources.
